qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Specialized MOCVD process know-how for GaN and SiC deposition, but lacks through-cycle economic moat proof: highly cyclical lumpy tool orders, volatile ROIC dropping to 11.5% in 2024 (and negative in 2015-2016), heavy customer concentration in Asia, and high export regulation risk.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Moat & Pricing Power, REJECT). Niche MOCVD equipment maker subject to violent boom-bust cycles in compound semiconductor (GaN/SiC) capex. Severe order volatility, ROIC dropping to ~11.5% in 2024 (and multi-year operating losses in past downturns), and concentrated Chinese customer exposure demonstrate lack of through-cycle pricing power.
qualitative.evidence: Revenue rose from €429M (2021) to €633M (2024), but historical track record reveals severe earnings volatility: EBIT was -€26.7M in 2015, -€21.4M in 2016, and +€4.9M in 2017. While ROIC peaked at ~25.7% during the 2021-2022 EV/SiC capex boom, it fell to ~11.5% in 2024 as power semi fab capacity saturated. Tools are lumpy one-off capital purchases that customers easily defer in downturns, with heavy revenue concentration in Asian foundries subject to geopolitical export licensing barriers.
